title: rosa × andegavensis var. oenensis
intro: Rosa × andegavensis var. oenensis, commonly known as the Alpine Sweetbriar, is a plant species in the rose family (Rosaceae). It is a fragrant, deciduous shrub native to the mountainous regions of Europe. The Alpine Sweetbriar has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The plant's therapeutic actions include its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, providing relief from various health conditions.
